text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that the Scarborough Community Council establish a Board of Management for the Cedarbrae Markham Lawrence Business Improvement area (BIA), appoint directors to that board and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Established a Board of Management for the Cedarbrae Markham Lawrence Business Improvement Area, consisting of six (6) directors, one (1) vacancy, and one (1) Councillor (Ward 24, Scarborough-Guildwood), for a total board size of eight (8), and make the necessary amendments to Schedule A of Municipal Code Chapter 19. 2.
